t: Stated in the first person, plainly
a: وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَعْلَمَ ٱلْمُجَـٰهِدِينَ مِنكُمْ وَٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ وَنَبْلُوَا۟ أَخْبَارَكُمْ
p: Wa la-nabluwannakum ḥattā naʿlama-l-mujāhidīna minkum wa-ṣ-ṣābirīn…
m: And We will surely test you until We make evident those who strive among you [for the cause of Allāh] and the patient, and We will test your affairs.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
